overview.text: 现 is the simplified form of 現, conventionally analyzed as 玉 ‘jade’ plus sound-giving 見. It commonly means ‘appear’ or ‘become visible’; 現 also has a recorded jade-luster sense, whose relation is unresolved.

components.text: 玉 contributes a jade association in traditional 現.
見 is conventionally analyzed as the sound element in 現; a cited Old Chinese comparison matches the ‘appear’ readings.

takeaway.text: The jade-luster and ‘appear’ uses are both recorded, but their chronology and connection remain unresolved.
